gaps.sentence: He kept ___ even though everyone had left.
There isn't ___ milk left in the fridge.
gaps.explanation: In negative sentences use 'any' with uncountable nouns.

gaps.sentence: He was sacked ___ repeatedly arriving late.
I'd rather walk than ___ the bus.
gaps.explanation: 'would rather do A than do B' — both bare infinitives.

gaps.sentence: We had the walls ___ last month.
gaps.explanation: 'have something done' = arrange for it to be done: had the walls painted.

gaps.sentence: He prefers cycling ___ driving to work.
The letters ___ delivered every morning at eight.
They marched through the capital ___ protest.
gaps.explanation: 'In protest' = as a way of protesting.
